name: get_portal_context
description: Read the current customer portal, its truthfulness rules and configured tone before answering tenant-specific questions.

name: navigate_portal
description: Move the visitor to one allowlisted section in the current Content Online customer portal. Never use arbitrary selectors or clicks.

name: get_portfolio_summary
description: Read the current tenant's allowed portfolio summary. Report authentication_required or synthetic_demo exactly as returned.

name: get_usage_summary
description: Read the current tenant's allowed usage summary including source mode and warning. Never infer missing values or financial benefit.
